title: Soft Foliage
description: Foliage should be fun. Let's fix that! Immersive leaves & lilypads, soft platforms, supports 26.1+, and an extensive config with toggles for vehicle and player based leaf collision!!! <3
body:
# Soft Foliage by KMV
## Foliage but more fun!!! 

### Current Features
- Soft Platforms (temp collision from top of soft foliage for navigation) -*temporarily disabled*-
- Soft Foliage (disables collision for leaf blocks and lilypads)
- Extensive Config (currently only accessible in config folder)
- Players toggle (no other mobs for now, except vehicles)
- Vehicles toggle (horses, boats, etc grouped for now)
- Lilypads included (boats break them rudely, will fix sometime)

##

### Future Features
- Config Screen ingame
- Slowdown option
- Mobs of varying types selectable from all, hostile, friendly, passive, player support mobs
- Items selectable
- Visual/Audio Feedback


##


### KMV's Promise:

My work focuses on maximum **compatibility** and **accessibility**, or ease of use. 

Help me ensure this by contacting me through my [Discord](https://discord.gg/XU8DDH3Fr2) server to report bugs or incompatibilities.
